$C=\dfrac{55583}{10}v^{-1}+\dfrac{583v}{600}$

$\dfrac{dC}{dv}=-\dfrac{55583}{10}v^{-2}+\dfrac{583}{600}$

Set $\dfrac{dC}{dv}=0$: $\dfrac{583}{600}=\dfrac{55583}{10v^2}$, so $v^2=\dfrac{55583\times 600}{10\times 583}=5720.377\ldots$, $v=75.633\ldots$ km/h ($v>0$).

Check nature: $C''=\dfrac{111166}{10}v^{-3}=\dfrac{111166}{10v^3}>0$ for all $v>0$, so $v=75.633\ldots$ km/h gives the minimum cost.

Minimum cost $=\dfrac{55583}{10\times 75.633\ldots}+\dfrac{583\times 75.633\ldots}{600}=\$146.98$ (nearest cent).
